verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
verses.translation: By the star when it descends,
Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: It is not but a revelation revealed,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
One of soundness.[1562] And he rose to [his] true form[1563]
verses.footnotes:
[1562]- i.e., strength of body and of mind.
[1563]- Gabriel appeared to Muḥammad (ﷺ) at the outset of his prophethood in the angelic form in which Allāh originally created him.

verses.translation: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.[1564]
verses.footnotes: [1564]- i.e., in the sky, above the eastern horizon.

verses.translation: Then he approached and descended
And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
And he revealed to His Servant[1565] what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
verses.footnotes: [1565]- i.e., to the Servant of Allāh, Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

verses.translation: The heart[1566] did not lie [about] what it saw.
verses.footnotes: [1566]- i.e., mind or perception (of the Prophet [ﷺ]).

verses.translation: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural, passive
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: And he certainly saw him in another descent[1567]
verses.footnotes: [1567]- i.e., on another occasion. During his ascent into the heavens (al-Miʿrāj), the Prophet (ﷺ) also saw Gabriel in his true form.

verses.translation: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].[1568]
verses.footnotes: [1568]- Then and there he (ﷺ) saw Gabriel in angelic form.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
verses.translation: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?
And Manāt, the third - the other one?[1569]
verses.footnotes: [1569]- The three names given in this and the previous verse are those of well-known "goddesses" which were worshipped by the pagan Arabs before the spread of Islām.

verses.translation: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
That, then, is an unjust division.[1570]

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.translation: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.translation: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

verses.arabic: وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
verses.translation: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
verses.translation: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.translation: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.translation: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
verses.translation: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.translation: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Have you seen the one who turned away
And gave a little and [then] refrained?
Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?[1571]
verses.footnotes: [1571]- Knows that his provision will be exhausted if he spends on the poor, while Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has promised otherwise.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.translation: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
And that his effort is going to be seen -

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And that to your Lord is the finality
And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
And that it is He who causes death and gives life
And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.
And that it is He who enriches and suffices
And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius[1572]
verses.footnotes: [1572]- A star worshipped by some of the pagan Arabs.

verses.translation: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad
And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
verses.translation: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
And the overturned towns[1573] He hurled down
And covered them by that which He covered.[1574]
Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.
The Approaching Day has approached.

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.translation: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.
Then at this statement do you wonder?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: And you laugh and do not weep

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: While you are proudly sporting?[1575]
verses.footnotes: [1575]- Additional meanings are "singing [with expanded chest]," "heedless," or "lost in vain amusements."

verses.translation: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].
